theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_dbd_lebesgue_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet A → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (A ∩ closedBall x ρ) / μ (closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (A.indicator 1 x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
